decision: Move modal backdrop color mapping into pure Theme::backdrop_style(Style). Remove per-cell NO_COLOR environment access and application-like color heuristics. Existing capability detection remains the owner of NO_COLOR precedence. Keep backdrop_colors(Color, Color) as the pair API.
